# Marriott Bonvoy
> Marriott Bonvoy is Marriott International’s travel platform for hotel booking, loyalty rewards, brand discovery, vacation rentals, and travel experiences.

Marriott.com helps travelers search and book stays across Marriott’s global portfolio of hotel brands, manage Marriott Bonvoy membership, redeem points, explore destinations, and access travel policies, customer support, and program terms.

## Booking & Search
- [Marriott Bonvoy Home](https://www.marriott.com/default.mi): Main entry point for hotel search, booking, offers, and member travel planning.
- [Find & Reserve a Hotel](https://www.marriott.com/search/findHotels.mi): Hotel search experience for destinations, dates, rates, and room availability.
- [Hotel Deals & Packages](https://www.marriott.com/deals/travel-deals.mi): Current promotions, packages, seasonal offers, and discounted member rates.
- [Hotel Brands](https://www.marriott.com/brands.mi): Directory of Marriott hotel brands across luxury, premium, select, and longer stays.
- [Destinations](https://www.marriott.com/travel.mi): Explore destinations, trip inspiration, and Marriott properties by location.
- [Meetings & Events](https://www.marriott.com/meeting-event-hotels/group-corporate-travel.mi): Group bookings, meetings, events, and corporate travel planning resources.

## Marriott Bonvoy Program
- [Marriott Bonvoy Overview](https://www.marriott.com/loyalty.mi): Overview of Marriott Bonvoy membership, earning, redemption, and travel benefits.
- [Join Marriott Bonvoy](https://www.marriott.com/loyalty/createAccount/createAccountPage1.mi): Enrollment page for creating a Marriott Bonvoy member account.
- [Member Benefits](https://www.marriott.com/loyalty/member-benefits.mi): Summary of member perks including rates, points, and elite recognition.
- [Elite Status](https://www.marriott.com/loyalty/member-benefits/elite.mi): Elite tiers, qualification requirements, and on-property loyalty benefits.
- [Redeem Points](https://www.marriott.com/loyalty/redeem.mi): Ways to use Marriott Bonvoy points for stays, experiences, and travel.
- [Marriott Bonvoy Terms & Conditions](https://www.marriott.com/loyalty/terms/default.mi): Official program rules, eligibility, earning, redemption, and benefit terms.

## Credit Cards & Points
- [Marriott Bonvoy Credit Cards](https://www.marriott.com/credit-cards.mi): Co-branded credit card options and points-earning travel benefits.
- [Buy Points](https://www.marriott.com/loyalty/purchasePoints.mi): Purchase Marriott Bonvoy points for future redemptions and account use.
- [Gift Cards](https://gifts.marriott.com/): Marriott gift cards for hotel stays, dining, and travel gifting.
- [Travel Partners](https://www.marriott.com/loyalty/earn/travel-partners.mi): Airline and travel partner relationships for earning and redeeming rewards.
- [Airline Miles Conversion](https://www.marriott.com/loyalty/redeem/travel/points-to-miles.mi): Convert Marriott Bonvoy points to participating airline frequent flyer miles.

## Homes, Villas & Residences
- [Homes & Villas by Marriott Bonvoy](https://homes-and-villas.marriott.com/): Premium and luxury home rental platform integrated with Marriott Bonvoy.
- [The Ritz-Carlton Residences](https://www.ritzcarlton.com/en/residences): Residential ownership offerings associated with Ritz-Carlton branded properties.
- [Marriott Executive Apartments](https://www.marriott.com/marriott-executive-apartments/travel.mi): Extended-stay apartment accommodations for business and long-term travelers.
- [Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy](https://apartments.marriott.com/): Apartment-style lodging and residential hospitality offerings under Marriott branding.

## Brands
- [The Ritz-Carlton](https://www.ritzcarlton.com/): Luxury hotels, resorts, residences, and destination experiences under Marriott’s flagship luxury brand.
- [St. Regis](https://st-regis.marriott.com/): Luxury hotels and resorts emphasizing bespoke service and premium travel experiences.
- [JW Marriott](https://jw-marriott.marriott.com/): Luxury hotels and resorts focused on wellness, service, and elevated stays.
- [W Hotels](https://w-hotels.marriott.com/): Lifestyle luxury hotels centered on design, nightlife, and contemporary travel.
- [Westin Hotels & Resorts](https://westin.marriott.com/): Wellness-oriented hotels with sleep, fitness, and restorative travel positioning.
- [Sheraton](https://sheraton.marriott.com/): Global full-service hotel brand for business and leisure travel.
- [Courtyard by Marriott](https://courtyard.marriott.com/): Select-service hotels designed for business travel and flexible stays.
- [Residence Inn](https://residenceinn.marriott.com/): Extended-stay hotels with suites, kitchens, and longer-visit amenities.

## Travel Experiences
- [Marriott Bonvoy Moments](https://moments.marriottbonvoy.com/): Redeem points for events, culinary experiences, sports, and entertainment access.
- [Marriott Bonvoy Tours & Activities](https://activities.marriott.com/): Book destination activities, excursions, and local experiences.
- [Restaurants & Bars](https://www.marriott.com/hotel-restaurants.mi): Discover on-property dining venues across Marriott hotels and resorts.
- [Spa](https://www.marriott.com/hotel-spa.mi): Explore spa offerings and wellness amenities at participating properties.
- [Golf](https://www.marriott.com/hotel-golf.mi): Golf resort and course experiences available across Marriott destinations.

## Customer Support & Account
- [Sign In](https://www.marriott.com/sign-in.mi): Member login for reservations, account management, and loyalty activity.
- [My Trips](https://www.marriott.com/lookupReservation.mi): Retrieve and manage upcoming reservations and travel details.
- [Customer Support](https://www.marriott.com/help.mi): Help center for reservations, account issues, and travel assistance.
- [Contact Us](https://www.marriott.com/about/contact.mi): Contact channels for customer service, reservations, and corporate inquiries.
- [Reservation Lookup](https://www.marriott.com/reservation/lookupReservation.mi): Find an existing booking using confirmation details and guest information.
- [Mobile App](https://mobile-app.marriott.com/): Marriott Bonvoy mobile app information for booking, check-in, and account access.

- [Cookie Preferences](https://www.marriott.com/about/cookies.mi): Cookie usage information and preference management for Marriott websites.

- [Open Source Software Notices](https://www.marriott.com/about/open-source-software.mi): Notices and attributions for open source software used by Marriott.
